item.ptxt: The bolts, screws and nuts required for removal/installation of the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly are indicated by symbols in the text and illustrations.
In the illustrations, D indicates the nominal diameter (mm) and L indicates the length under the head (mm).

s-1.ptxt: Handling and Work Precautions
Disconnect Battery Negative Terminal
Remove Instrument Cluster Finish Panel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Operate the tilt lever to lower the steering wheel.
Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Disengage the 9 clips and 2 claws, and remove the instrument cluster finish panel.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Combination Meter Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 screws.
Pull the combination meter assembly toward the rear of the vehicle, disconnect the connectors, and remove the combination meter assembly.

atten3.ptxt: When removing the combination meter assembly, be careful not to damage the instrument panel safety pad and combination meter assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Finish Panel End RH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Insert a roof molding remover and move it near the clip engagement as shown in the illustration.
As shown in the illustration, pull the roof molding remover with both hands in the direction of the arrow to disengage the clip.
Disengage the 3 clips and remove the instrument panel finish panel end RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Finish Panel End LH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Insert a roof molding remover and move it near the clip engagement as shown in the illustration.
As shown in the illustration, pull the roof molding remover with both hands in the direction of the arrow to disengage the clip.
Disengage the 3 clips and remove the instrument panel finish panel end LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Register Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Pull the instrument panel register assembly CTR horizontally toward the rear of the vehicle to disengage the 2 clips, 5 claws and 3 guides.
Disconnect the connector and remove the instrument panel register assembly CTR.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece RH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Using a thin flat-tip screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, disengage the 5 claws and 2 guides A.
Disengage the 2 guides B and remove the front pillar garnish corner piece RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Pull the upper part of the garnish in the direction of arrow (1) shown in the illustration to disengage the clip and front pillar garnish clip.
Using nippers or equivalent, cut the front pillar garnish clip.
Pull the garnish in the direction of arrow (2) shown in the illustration, disengage the guide and remove the front pillar garnish RH.
Using a clip remover, remove the front pillar garnish clip from the front pillar RH.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to replace the installed front pillar garnish clip with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Curtain Shield Airbag Protection

atten3.ptxt: Immediately after removing the front pillar garnish RH, install a protective cover onto the curtain shield airbag.

s3.ptxt: Using cloth or nylon, wrap the airbag portion as shown in the illustration and fix both ends of the cloth or nylon with packing tape.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece LH

atten4.ptxt: Remove using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish LH

s2.ptxt: Pull the upper part of the garnish in the direction of arrow (1) shown in the illustration to disengage the 2 clips.
Using nippers or equivalent, cut the front pillar garnish clip.
Pull the garnish in the direction of arrow (2) shown in the illustration, disengage the guide and remove the front pillar garnish LH.
Using a clip remover, remove the front pillar garnish clip from the front pillar LH.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to replace the installed front pillar garnish clip with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Curtain Shield Airbag Protection

atten3.ptxt: Immediately after removing the front pillar garnish LH, install a protective cover onto the curtain shield airbag.

s3.ptxt: Using cloth or nylon, wrap the airbag portion as shown in the illustration and fix both ends of the cloth or nylon with packing tape.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Shift Lever Knob

s2.ptxt: Turn the shift lever knob in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Console Box Cover Rear

s2.ptxt: Using a thin flat-tip screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, disengage the 2 clips.
Place your hand at the position shown in the illustration and disengage the 2 clips.
Disconnect the connectors and remove the console box rear cover.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Position Indicator Housing Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 7 claws.
Disconnect the connector and remove the position indicator housing assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Finish Panel Lower Center

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws <C>.
Disengage the 6 clips and 4 claws, and remove the instrument panel finish panel LWR CTR.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Glove Compartment Door Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disengage the claw and disconnect the glove compartment door stopper.
Slightly deform parts A and B shown in the illustration in the direction of the arrows, release the 2 stoppers and pull out the glove compartment door assembly until it is horizontal.
Pull the glove compartment door assembly horizontally toward the rear of the vehicle, disengage the 2 hinge claws and remove the glove compartment door assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Always pull horizontally to remove the glove compartment door assembly, as pulling it upward causes looseness in the hinge.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Cluster Finish End Panel

s2.ptxt: Pull the instrument cluster finish panel end horizontally toward the rear of the vehicle and remove the instrument panel cluster finish end.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Box Door Sub-assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws <B>.
Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Place your hand at the position shown in the illustration and disengage the clips and claws.
Place your hand at the position shown in the illustration and disengage the 2 clips and 2 claws.
Pull in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to pull out the upper part of instrument panel box No.1.
Pull in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration and remove instrument panel box No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Connector for Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the instrument panel passenger airbag assembly connector.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Upper w/ Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Operate the tilt lever to lower the steering wheel.
Disconnect the connectors.
Remove the 2 screws <B>.
Remove the 2 instrument panel passenger airbag assembly installation bolts <A>.
Disengage the 4 clips and 3 claws.
Pull toward the rear of the vehicle, disengage the 5 claws and remove the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly.

atten3.ptxt: When removing the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly, work so as not to damage the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly and steering wheel assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Defroster Nozzle Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 screws <B> and remove the defroster nozzle assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Heater to Register Duct NO.2

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 screws <B> and remove the heater to register duct No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Heater to Register Duct NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws <B> and remove the heater to register duct No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Heater to Register Duct NO.3

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 screws <B> and remove the heater to register duct No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Ion Generator

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 2 screws and remove the ion generator w/ bracket.
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the ion generator from the bracket.
